name: Slopfolio
description: Turn something you built with AI into a private Slopfolio draft that you review and publish yourself.

permissions.label: Check your drafts
permissions.description: Read whether a draft your agent prepared is still a draft, was published, or was deleted, and its post link once live.

permissions.label: Prepare private drafts
permissions.description: Create and revise private drafts on your Slopfolio account from what you paste. Never publishes: you approve and publish on Slopfolio.
